notes.title: Easy Mode Added!
notes.notes:
I've been listening to all the feedback and have now implemented an Easy Mode for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43110204/2015179af88f6836efefb100be12116a64aa5ded.png[/img]
You can access the Easy Mode Toggle in the options menu at the title screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43110204/675751ba8cc7c9097f18341cbea555c52f9cc062.png[/img]
Or change it in game on the fly so you don't have to go back to the title screen!

[u][b]List of differences in Easy Mode:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43110204/5f7d697395143b478a719a5e6f9549d35f13150e.png[/img]
You now start off with 5 lives instead of 3.

All of your weapons are now stronger, so most normal enemies will go down in one hit and the mini bosses and bosses will go down faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43110204/37f0f0696cdc2c30e8587468d369f0fc3be17283.png[/img]
The game's most difficult boss in Stage 2, The Cookieroid Monster's 2nd form can now be defeated with normal weapons as indicated on the top right.

You can also play through all of the bonus modes in Easy Mode. While you will still need to put some time and effort to get all of the achievements, it should be much easier now.

There are no new achievements nor any of the current achievements have been altered. You can get every achievement with Easy Mode.

For those who still prefer the original challenge, you can still turn off Easy Mode and the game will go back to normal difficulty.

The Easy Mode update is now live here on Steam, itch.io and on the PS5. Epic and Xbox should be updated later this week. The demo version of the game also has the new Easy Mode.

Hopefully people can now have a more relaxed time playing and enjoy the silly characters and story without breaking their controllers in rage. As the game is continuing to sell well on all the current platforms it's on, I've been taking the criticism and feedback to heart and have been making improvements to make the game more accessible to everyone.

I will be addressing the localization of the game in other languages in a future update, so stay tuned for that.

Enjoy!

- Ryan

notes.title: Start and Continue Game Fix!
notes.notes:
Now when you start or continue the game, you will get extra prompts asking if you want to load your game and it will display the progress on the bottom of the screen. I know many people have accidentally saved over their progress by starting a new game as the game saves at the start of each level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43110204/941b537277f1516e6fd14f703056b406076b395e.png[/img]
Start Game will now ask you if you want to overwrite your progress and start over from the beginning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43110204/9a311077a9e190b6365d4c400d597f85fea537a8.png[/img]
Continue Game will ask if you you want to load your game or restart any completed level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43110204/c14bdca2a996ee94067210849e00699c16284dbc.png[/img]
You can start from any completed level from the Continue Game option and levels you haven't completed are locked.

Hopefully this will prevent people from overwriting their save data and will show your progress.

This update is now live here on Steam, Epic, and the PS5. The Xbox update is still being approved by Microsoft, but should be done by the end of the week.

Happy Poppin'!

- Ryan

notes.notes:

notes.title: Popcorn Rocket Demo Update 4/24/23!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kll9sHp.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BGwoCVz.jpg[/img]

Based on recent feedback I've gotten, I've added text indicators above the power ups to indicate the type of weapon each of the popcorn power ups will give you. No more guessing and getting a weapon you don't want!

I have also added an indicator for kernels and nova bombs showing how much you've collected and added to your total amount.

Also, I have done more optimization to reduce lag in certain parts along with fixing the bugs I've seen in recent let's plays of the game on YouTube. Watching these videos has been incredibly helpful since people can catch all the stuff that I've been unable to catch.

I'm still working hard on the achievements for the full game which have been incredibly difficult to work with, but every day I'm getting closer to making them work properly. We're getting very close to the finish line, but we're still a ways off.

The demo should automatically update and enjoy!

If you have any additional feedback on the demo, or want to report more bugs and glitches, let me know!

- Ryan

notes.title: Popcorn Rocket Demo Update 4/5/2013!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, based on the demo feedback, I have made a ton of new updates to make things a far better experience for players. Here are the updates for 4/5/2023!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j0mJq8m.png[/img]
[b]New Control Reference Sheet[/b]
Players who need to know the exact controller and keyboard controls can now access a nifty sheet in the options and pause menu!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Thq1vQI.png[/img]
[b]Rapid Fire Option[/b]
Tired of mashing your thumb to fire? Now you can turn on rapid fire to just hold down the fire button to blast away at enemies! No more carpal tunnel syndrome!

[b]Boss Warning Skip[/b]
You can now press select/back/shift to skip the "WARNING" alert at bosses so you can get right into the action when you continue!

[b]2nd Form Boss Continue Spot[/b]
If you lose to the 2nd form of a boss and continue, you can start over at the 2nd form without having to beat the first form again!

Huge thanks to everyone who's given constructive feedback over the week! It's really helped me make the game better and more accessible to more players!

If you have more feedback or if there's bugs, let me know!

- Ryan
